critical_code_review_comments: normalize_news_category_renames silently drops rename entries whose target is not in the effective_categories list; consider returning 400 to surface user intent errors instead of silent no-op.

In PUT /site/content, when the client also includes an announcements list along with news_categories, the code runs two normalization passes (rename block, then generic block). The generic pass overwrites the fallback assignment; behavior is consistent, but the double pass adds cognitive load — worth refactoring to a single normalization step.
